subject.title: fix: block unsafe workspace dotenv controls [AI]

question: Should repository-local dotenv files be prohibited from setting the added AWS credential/profile and authentication-control variables, with trusted shell and global dotenv files remaining allowed sources?
rationale: This patch extends a security policy boundary rather than only correcting a mechanical implementation detail; the protected maintainer label and upgrade impact require an owner to confirm the intended trust model.

options.title: Confirm the expanded denylist
options.body: Accept the listed variables as workspace-untrusted controls after a redacted runtime transcript proves workspace rejection and trusted fallback behavior.

options.title: Narrow the policy
options.body: Retain only variables that demonstrably alter OpenClaw provider, channel, or security behavior and remove generic AWS development variables from this boundary.
